training_sample_ids.description: Exact sample_id values from data/metadata.csv used to fit coefficients. Cohort aliases, wildcards, and count placeholders are invalid. In data_withheld only, use the single marker DOCUMENTED-NOT-EXECUTED.

tuning_sample_ids.description: Exact sample_id values used for hyperparameter or threshold tuning; empty when none. A sample may appear in more than one role because roles record uses, not disjoint partitions.

feature_selection_sample_ids.description: Exact sample_id values used to choose genes; empty for a genuinely prespecified panel. Replication sample IDs here mean replication was not untouched.
